privacy.title: Policy y'Eby'ekyama
privacy.s1Body: Great Sport Bets ekuŋŋaanya amawulire agakukwatako amatono ageetaagisa okukola akawunti n'okufuna Premium, nga mw'otwalidde email ne ebikwata ku kusasula ebikolebwa mu ngeri ey'okwerinda nga Stripe (web) ne Google Play / RevenueCat (Android).
privacy.s2Body: Tukozesa amawulire go okukuwa access ku tips zaffe z'okubetanga, okukola ebisasulo, n'okuddukanya enkola y'okutuusa abalala. Tetutunda data yo ey'ekyama eri abantu bandi.
privacy.s3Body: Tukozesa enkola z'okwerinda ez'omutindo ogwa industry nga Supabase, Stripe, Google Play ne RevenueCat okukuuma data yo. Kyokka, tewali ngeri y'okusindika ku Yintaneeti ey'okwerinda 100%.
privacy.s4Body: Bw'oba n'ebibuuzo ku Nkola eno y'Obw'ekyama, kutuukirira ku greatsportbets@gmail.com.

terms.title: Ebiragiro by'Okukozesa
terms.s1Body: Great Sport Bets ewa amagezi n'ebiteeso by'okuteeba n'ebiteeso eby'okuteeba eby'akataalo (surebets). Tetuwa buweereza bwa kuteeba oba amagezi ku by'ensimbi. Emirimu gyonna gy'okuteeba giri ku kabi kyo.
terms.s2Body: Okufuna Premium kuweebwa ng'oyita mu kwewandiisa ku Android (Google Play, nga kikolebwa mu RevenueCat) ne mu kugula emirundi gumu ku web (nga kikolebwa mu Stripe). Okwewandiisa kwa Google Play kugoberera amateeka n'enkola z'okusasula n'okuzza ssente za Google Play. Okugula ku web tekuzzibwa ssente oluvannyuma lw'okufuna obukkiriza.
terms.s3Body: Enkola yaffe y'okutuusa abalala ya kukozesebwa muntu ku lwe. Okukozesa obubi, nga mw'otwaliddemu okwetusa ku y'oyo yennyini oba okutondawo akawunti n'olimba, kijja kuviirako akawunti kusazibwamu ssekinnoomu n'okufiirwa bonasi.
terms.s4Body: Great Sport Bets teyakakasa kufuna. Ebisobye tebiraga bibaawo mu maaso. Bulijjo teeba mu ngeri ey'okwegendereza.

deletion.title: Okusazaamu Akawunti ne Data
deletion.intro: Ku Great Sport Bets, tussa ekitiibwa mu by'ekyama byo era tuwa enkola ennyonnyola bulungi okusazaamu akawunti yo ne data yo ey'obuntu.
deletion.warningBody: Okusazaamu akawunti yo kwa lubeerera. Ojja kufiirwa omutindo gwa Premium, bonasi z'okutuusa abalala, n'ebyafaayo. Ekikolwa kino tekisobola kukyusibwa.
deletion.step1: Weereza email eri <email>{{email}}</email> okuva ku adiresi ya email ekwatagana n'akawunti yo ya Great Sport Bets.
deletion.step2: Teekamu "Okusaba Okusazaamu Akawunti" ku mutwe gw'email.
deletion.step3: Okusaba kwo kujja kukolebwa mu nnaku 7 ez'emirimu. Ojja kufuna email ey'okukakasa oluvannyuma lw'okusazaamu okumalirizibwa.
deletion.deleted1: Adiresi ya email ne profayiro y'okukakasa
deletion.deleted2: Ebikwata ku kufuna Premium n'ebyafaayo by'okusasula
deletion.keptBody: Ku lw'okugoberera amateeka n'ebiragiro by'ebyensimbi (ng'okutegeeza omusolo ku kusasula kwa Stripe ne Google Play), tusobola okutereka ID z'okukola emirimu ne metadata okutuusa ku myaka 5. Data eno tekkwatagana na bukya bwo obw'omuntu era ekoseddwa butereevu mu kukebera.
